notes: Unfilled on purpose. The Secretary of State's business-formation FAQ was reachable and states nothing about turnaround or expedited service, and the two pages that would carry the figures — the fee-and-payment schedule and the expedited-services page — returned HTTP 403 to automated access on the date below. Texas is widely reported to charge a flat expedite fee set by statute, but no official page was opened to confirm the amount, the turnaround it buys, or whether it applies to a Certificate of Formation, so nothing is recorded here. An unfilled field is recoverable; a plausible wrong number is not.
needsReview: Every expedite field and the standard-processing fields. Blocked by bot protection on www.sos.state.tx.us, not by absence of a source. Retry on a direct connection: (1) the Secretary of State's fee and payment schedule, (2) its expedited-services page, and (3) the Government Code section that sets the expedite fee, read from the Legislature's own statute site rather than any mirror.
